timeline.event: Lucy, an early human ancestor, lives in the Afar region
timeline.label: c. 3.2 million years ago

timeline.event: The kingdom of D'mt flourishes in the northern highlands
timeline.label: c. 800 BCE

timeline.event: The Kingdom of Aksum rises as a Red Sea trading power
timeline.label: c. 100 CE

timeline.event: King Ezana of Aksum adopts Christianity
timeline.label: c. 330

timeline.event: Aksumite king Kaleb leads an expedition across the Red Sea to Yemen
timeline.label: c. 525

timeline.event: The rock-hewn churches of Lalibela are carved
timeline.label: c. 1200

timeline.event: Yekuno Amlak founds the Solomonic dynasty
Imam Ahmad is defeated and killed at the Battle of Wayna Daga
Emperor Fasilides makes Gondar the royal capital
Tewodros II is crowned, ending the Era of the Princes
Menelik II and Empress Taytu found Addis Ababa
Ethiopia defeats Italy at the Battle of Adwa
Ras Tafari is crowned Emperor Haile Selassie
Fascist Italy invades Ethiopia
Haile Selassie returns to Addis Ababa as Italian rule collapses
Abebe Bikila wins the Olympic marathon in Rome running barefoot
The Organisation of African Unity is founded in Addis Ababa
The Derg deposes Emperor Haile Selassie
Eritrea becomes independent from Ethiopia
The African Union, headquartered in Addis Ababa, replaces the OAU

places.name: Addis Ababa
places.clue: Founded in 1886, Ethiopia's capital hosts the African Union and sits about 2,350 m above sea level.

places.name: Rock-Hewn Churches of Lalibela
places.clue: Eleven medieval churches carved down into solid rock, including the cross-shaped Bete Giyorgis.

places.name: Aksum
places.clue: Capital of an ancient trading kingdom, famous for its towering carved granite stelae.

places.name: Lake Tana
places.clue: Ethiopia's largest lake and the source of the Blue Nile, with island monasteries.

places.name: Simien Mountains National Park
places.clue: Jagged peaks and cliffs home to geladas and the rare Walia ibex.

places.name: Gondar
places.clue: Royal capital founded by Emperor Fasilides, whose castle compound Fasil Ghebbi still stands.

places.name: Harar
places.clue: A walled eastern city of narrow alleys, famous for its 'hyena men'.

places.name: Dallol
places.clue: Hydrothermal field in the Danakil Depression with vivid yellow, green and orange mineral pools.

places.name: Bale Mountains National Park
places.clue: High Afro-alpine plateau that shelters the largest population of the Ethiopian wolf.

places.name: Erta Ale
places.clue: A shield volcano in the Afar lowlands known for its long-lived lava lake.

places.name: Sof Omar Caves
places.clue: One of Africa's longest cave systems, carved through limestone by the Weyib River.

places.name: Konso
places.clue: UNESCO-listed landscape of stone terraces, walled hilltop towns and carved wooden grave markers.
